# FocusFlow Lab

> FocusFlow Lab makes simple study systems for students: fewer phone distractions, notes that stick, calmer exam weeks. It runs a YouTube channel, a free printable Study Focus Kit, free exam study plan generators and a $5 Exam Sprint Planner.

## Free tools
- [NCLEX study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/nclex/): week-by-week NCLEX-RN plan from your exam date, daily hours and weak client-needs areas. Free, no sign-up, prints cleanly.
- [MCAT study schedule generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/mcat/): week-by-week MCAT plan across all four sections, with CARS every week and full-length tests in the second half.
- [NCLEX-PN study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/nclex-pn/)
- [USMLE Step 1 study schedule generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/usmle-step-1/)
- [GRE study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/gre/)
- [LSAT study schedule generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/lsat/)
- [PANCE study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/pance/)
- [NAPLEX study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/naplex/)
- [CPA FAR study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/cpa-far/)
- [TEAS study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/teas/)
- [DAT study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/dat/)
- [GMAT study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/gmat/)
- [CPA AUD study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/cpa-aud/)
- [CPA REG study plan generator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/cpa-reg/)
- [All study plan generators](https://thefocusflowlab.com/study-plan/)
- [Focus timer](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/focus-timer/): focus blocks with breaks and a self-test prompt.
- [Exam countdown](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/exam-countdown/): days and real study hours left before an exam.
- [Test time calculator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/test-time-calculator/): minutes per question and pacing checkpoints for a timed test.
- [Spaced review calendar](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/spaced-review/): review dates 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days out, exportable to a calendar.
- [Final grade calculator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/final-grade-calculator/): the score needed on a final exam to reach a target course grade.
- [GPA calculator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/gpa-calculator/): semester and cumulative GPA on the US 4.0 scale.
- [Weighted grade calculator](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/weighted-grade-calculator/): course grade from weighted categories.
- [Study schedule maker](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/study-schedule-maker/): weekly study hours per subject up to each exam date.
- [Reading planner](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/reading-planner/): pages per day to finish a reading by a deadline.
- [Flashcards](https://thefocusflowlab.com/tools/flashcards/): flashcards with spaced repetition, stored in the browser.
